name: x-article-thumbnails
title_zh: 先出概念稿再谈生成的封面设计搭档
tagline_zh: 选题定了但封面总差口气？它先帮你把构图、视觉隐喻、标题排版拆成可读的概念方案，再给生成提示词。
tagline_en: Stuck on cover design? It turns your topic into readable concepts—composition, visual metaphor, title layout—then.
desc_en: Design article thumbnail concepts, generation prompts, and precise image revisions. Use for reference selection, readable workflow diagrams, visual style extraction, or coordinated title and thumbnail packaging.
why_zh: 不是直接丢一张图，而是先把设计决策显性化：参考图选哪张、流程图怎么排、风格从哪提取，每一步都有据可改。
why_en: It externalizes design decisions before pixels exist—reference choice, diagram flow, style extraction—so revisions target a.
limit_zh: 只产出概念方案与提示词，不生成图片本身；需要你自带图像生成工具或 API。改图指令依赖你提供当前图与目标差异。
limit_en: Outputs concepts and prompts only—no image rendering. Requires your own image API/tool. Revisions need an existing image plus your change request.
title_en: Thumbnail concept drafts before any image generation
